title: Add multiply(a, b) to calc.ts
body: Export a `multiply(a, b)` function from calc.ts that returns a * b. Acceptance: calc.test.ts asserts multiply(3, 4) returns 12.

title: add() concatenates string input
body:
Steps to reproduce: call add("1", 2) from calc.ts.
Expected: it throws a TypeError.
Actual: it returns "12".
Add a regression test to calc.test.ts.

title: Add subtract(a, b) with a unit test
body: Export `subtract(a, b)` from calc.ts returning a - b, covered by a test in calc.test.ts.

title: Improve performance
body: The app feels slow. Make it faster.

title: Make onboarding better
body: New users struggle to get started. Onboarding should be nicer and more intuitive.

title: Restyle the header button
body: The header button looks off. Change its color to the brand blue and fix the padding so it matches the mockup.

title: Rotate the production Stripe secret key
body: The prod STRIPE_SECRET_KEY was printed in a build log. Rotate it and update calc.ts config loading to read the new key.

body:
